title: Glowing paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boatGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF4C2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD966'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hullGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE27A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F0B429'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sailGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9DB'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='aura' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD966' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFB347' stop-opacity='0.12'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB347' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='42' ry='30' fill='url(#aura)'/>

  <!-- water reflection lines -->
  <path d='M10 76 Q22 71 34 76 Q46 81 58 76 Q70 71 82 76 Q90 79 94 77' fill='none' stroke='#7EE8FA' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M14 83 Q26 78 38 83 Q50 88 62 83 Q74 78 86 83' fill='none' stroke='#9BF0FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.75'/>
  <path d='M22 90 Q32 86 42 90 Q52 94 62 90 Q72 86 82 90' fill='none' stroke='#9BF0FF' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- paper boat hull -->
  <path d='M18 68 L50 60 L82 68 L72 80 Q50 87 28 80 Z' fill='url(#hullGlow)' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- hull fold detail -->
  <path d='M50 60 L50 84 M33 64 L28 78 M67 64 L72 78' fill='none' stroke='#E09B00' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hull rim highlight -->
  <path d='M18 68 L50 60 L82 68' fill='none' stroke='#FFF9DB' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- main sail (triangle) -->
  <path d='M50 22 L50 60 L28 60 Z' fill='url(#sailGlow)' stroke='#FFC233' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- small sail -->
  <path d='M52 32 L52 60 L68 60 Z' fill='#FFE58F' stroke='#FFC233' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- mast -->
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='62' stroke='#FFD257' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sail highlights -->
  <path d='M48 28 L48 50' stroke='#FFFBE6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M54 38 L54 52' stroke='#FFFBE6' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- little star sparkles around boat -->
  <g fill='#FFF9DB'>
    <path d='M16 40 L17.4 43.6 L21 45 L17.4 46.4 L16 50 L14.6 46.4 L11 45 L14.6 43.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 32 L85.1 34.9 L88 36 L85.1 37.1 L84 40 L82.9 37.1 L80 36 L82.9 34.9 Z' opacity='0.85'/>
    <path d='M74 52 L74.9 54.1 L77 55 L74.9 55.9 L74 58 L73.1 55.9 L71 55 L73.1 54.1 Z' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny glow dots -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='52' r='1.6' fill='#FFF4C2' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='46' r='1.3' fill='#FFF4C2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='1' fill='#FFF9DB' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#FFF9DB' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
